title: rosa rubiginosa var. nemorosa
intro: Rosa rubiginosa var. nemorosa, commonly known as the wild briar or wild rose, is a fragrant and thorny deciduous shrub that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relief from anxiety, stress, and menstrual cramps due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rubiginosa var. nemorosa include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent, helping to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
